rootReview.method: Preserved source and changed-line reviews, current source-hash checks, settled UI observation and evidence consistency review.
rootReview.claims: No completed desktop acceptance, fully saturated final reply, or all-green daemon-suite claim.

checks: Historical structured originals preserved against their prior manifest
Current tracked source and standalone suite hashes match the 31-path candidate
Frozen review snapshot hashes match the independent receipts
Actual final counts and failure identities agree with bounded logs
Current browser result, progress and task-selection observations retained with their limits
Recorded references resolve; JSON and event records parse
Scoped credential and forbidden-file scans pass
Current browser revoked and isolated resources stopped; protected identities retained
limitations: Desktop installation and first open remain not-run
Full daemon suite remains failed with known cases
Final accurate busy reply is not a two-slot-saturation repeat
Later seat delta is root-reviewed, not independently reviewed

initialIndependentReview.scope: The original approval, candidate-base persistence and telemetry wiring fixes.

runtimeIndependentReview.scope: The frozen 27-path runtime candidate and its amendment, followed by the R1-1 fix and direct delta regression confirmation.
notCovered: final acceptance run and evidence refresh

laterSeatDelta.note: The historical review receipt named the full suite pending; the later actual result is recorded separately and remains failed with the two known cases.

simplification.reason: No additional refactor or unrelated cleanup was introduced.
